concreteFinding.problem: First NUL-delimited stream: OK prefix is accepted before peer close, without ruling out trailing data or an early response before complete request transmission.
concreteFinding.disposition: Reported to root; root owns scanner protocol patch and negative protocol tests. No duplicate patch made.
concreteFinding.expectedFix: Require complete INSTREAM send and a bounded, exact total NUL-framed OK response only after clean peer completion; reject all early/trailing/malformed/oversized/timeout/error outcomes.
